author: STAN CHOE
title: U.S. Stock Markets Decline Amid AI Frenzy and Economic Concerns
text:
• U.S. stock indexes fell sharply on February 27, 2025.
• The S&P 500 dropped 1.6%, marking its fifth decline in six days.
• The S&P 500 has lost 1.4% of its rally since Election Day.
• The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.47%.
• The Nasdaq composite tumbled 2.8%.
• Nvidia's stock fell 7.1% after initially rising due to a better-than-expected profit report.
• Nvidia's performance was impacted by competition from a Chinese company, DeepSeek.
• Salesforce's stock fell 3.8% despite exceeding profit expectations.
• Snowflake's stock rose 5.7% after reporting stronger-than-expected profit and revenue.
• Berkshire Hathaway's stock rose 1.7%, contributing positively to the S&P 500.
• Visa and UnitedHealth Group saw gains of 1.1% and 1.5%, respectively.
• Nvidia accounted for over 22% of the total return for the S&P 500 last year.
• President Trump announced that tariffs on imports from Canada and Mexico will go into effect on March 4.
• An additional 10% tariff on Chinese products was also announced.
• Concerns about tariffs are causing U.S. households to feel more nervous about the economy.
• Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City President Jeff Schmid expressed caution regarding inflation easing.
• The U.S. economy's performance estimate for the last three months of 2024 was left unchanged.
• Unemployment benefit applications reached a three-month high but remain low compared to past recessions.
• The yield on the 10-year Treasury rose to 4.28% from 4.26%.
• European and Asian stock markets showed mixed results, with Germany's DAX losing 1.1% and Japan's Nikkei 225 gaining 0.3%.
